description: Ask in plain words, e.g. "who fixes dryers in Franklin, TN?" or "HVAC near 37013". Returns a short sourced answer packet: up to 5 local businesses, each with its facts (phone, verified status with date, claimed, distance), how AssistAnt knows them, a confidence level, and what we do not know. Order: verified, then claimed, then distance; placement cannot be bought.

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP (else the town is read from the question or town + state)

name: ask
title: Ask the directory a plain question
